svg.title: How the mean resultant length R is calculated
svg.desc: Spawning records become arrows on a lunar circle. Their mean east and north parts give an average arrow, and its length is R. The loop shows Raffles Lighthouse, Akajima, Eilat and a made-up example with two opposite groups.

g.text: The arrows agree, so little cancels
Most arrows agree, a few pull away
Arrows point all round and cancel
Two tight groups, yet they cancel
